strongest_angle: Researchers at the University of Southampton deployed artificial intelligence to process 100,000 pages of historical port books, revealing 461 years of British maritime trade and empire building.

key_facts.fact: Researchers at the University of Southampton used artificial intelligence to process about 100,000 pages of handwritten records spanning 461 years of Britain's maritime past.
The University of Southampton project created a first-of-its-kind online interactive map using data extracted from port records to chart Britain's growth into a global trading nation.
Smithsonian Magazine reported on the new searchable online database detailing how Britain built a global empire by trading goods like coal, wine, and wood.
